scope: Improve update reliability and document clipboard recovery.

topics.title: Maintenance testing build
details: This build focuses on installing updates reliably and keeping document copy and paste working when Windows clipboard access is temporarily unavailable.
The file manager and supported document-reader features introduced in the previous build remain available.

topics.title: Updates close the browser connection before installation
details: Companion closes its installed browser connection helpers before starting Setup, so they no longer keep application files in use after the main app closes.
Only helpers from the matching Companion installation are closed. Your regular Chrome or Edge browser is not closed.

topics.title: Document copy and paste recover from clipboard errors
details: When Windows cannot open the clipboard, Companion keeps the copied document text in its internal clipboard so it can still be pasted within Companion.
